bug_semantics: POST /api/images (route.json path /images/*) ran the CMS image uploader without authentication. Filename [context]multerFile[auth].js encodes after=context and before=auth, so multerFile (and [multerFile]upload.js after it) execute before the global auth middleware. At the 2.0.1 tree that writes files via CustomMemoryStorage plus uploadFile mkdir/writeFile; earlier the same handler used multer.diskStorage with mkdirSync. Auth that honors access:private therefore runs after the disk write/200 response. getMulter.js fileFilter only checks the client-supplied MIME type, which the reporter also bypassed; the shipped fix did not change that filter.
flaw_origin: a2f514ad10073fb9ae164446f30205086151c095 (RESTful api implementation, parent 4e518e617b76928656936e0048da852229acf24e) first attached the image-upload handler to the non-admin REST route packages/evershop/src/modules/cms/api/imageUpload/ (git R072 from api/admin/imageUpload) and newly wrote JWT auth that treats a missing route access field as public, plus parseFromFile.js API default m.after payloadValidate instead of auth. Parent 4e518e61 already had imageUpload/route.json POST /images/* with no access field, but cat-file shows [context]multerFile[auth].js absent on that REST path; admin-scoped /image/upload/* is a different route. Later 4b97829d added access:private (incomplete: order still before auth). Filename lineage [componee]->[session]->[auth] is older admin refactors, not the /api/images sink.

At a2f514ad, imageUpload/route.json has POST /images/* with no access; auth.js comments 'Missing access property means public'; parseFromFile API default after changes from auth to payloadValidate. 4b97829d adds access:private. v2.0.1 still has [context]multerFile[auth].js and parseFromFile API default after=['escapeHtml'] (not auth); 65ec4780 later adds default after auth only when !m.after, so this filename is unchanged. reasoning: The advisory is a real unauthenticated upload (CWE-434) on POST /api/images, reproduced in #819 and accepted by the maintainer; CVE.org remains PUBLISHED so this is not FALSE_POSITIVE. The v2.0.1 sink is middleware order: multerFile is explicitly before auth, so access:private cannot prevent the write. That REST sink is first assembled in a2f514ad, which is the smallest public commit that both places the uploader on /images/* and makes API auth public-by-default; the parent tree lacks the handler at the REST path. Git records R072 from api/admin/imageUpload, but that was a different admin route (/image/upload/*) under admin scope; treating the REST exposure as a no-op move would miss the new unauthenticated sink a2f514ad actually wrote (auth.js missing-access=public and parseFromFile dropping default after=auth). Single parent, no reconstructible members, so not a decomposable squash. Filename-only refactors (b272c422 first write of admin multer, 471a4033/3f26b6ef bracket renames) are earlier carriers of before-late-middleware, not the /api/images BIC. 4b97829d and 65ec4780 are incomplete remediations. AI is judged only from the a2f514ad commit object: human The Nguyen, no AI author/committer/trailer. Fix fc224b57 is also human and is the atomic order patch.
